items.title: 60499_Garvin Bushell oral history interview
items.q: He's like Louis, he hit the scene just like Louis did and exploded on the scene.

ctx.x: I'm sure he had no trouble when he got to New York.

Oh, he got a job, he worked at a place called the Garden of Joy, a big Rock (unintelligible) from there on he joined Fletcher -- went down to the -- not the Bamboo Inn, another place on 129th Street. That's where Fletcher heard him. Yeah, he's a great artist. Been nothing like him anyplace on any instrument. He's like Louis, he hit the scene just like Louis did and exploded on the scene. Nobody ever played jazz on any instrument like Coleman. No, I think -- I played with him for five years later on with…
